prior_attempt.failure: Standalone script omitted repository root from sys.path; no data was opened or evaluated.

objective: Recompute exact residuals, current guard outcomes, 2-norm condition estimates, and high-precision backward error on five archived 175x175 complex systems and three vectors each. No assembly or linear solve.

upstream_manifest_observation.mismatched_files: five per-frequency JSON files and guard_resolution_summary.json; comparison only

criteria.exact_pass: Exact rational squared residual ratio <= exact square of binary64(1e-7)
criteria.exact_fail: Exact rational squared residual ratio > exact square of binary64(1e-7)
criteria.inconclusive: Nonfinite, malformed, unsupported dtype, or exact evaluation over budget
criteria.current_guard: Recompute current main guard from stored A, b and x; no solver/assembly; record actual decision
criteria.condition_number: Recompute 2-norm condition estimate from stored impedance
criteria.threshold_policy: Do not change threshold or historical route decisions

method.primary: Exact Fraction arithmetic for represented float values and complex operations; compare squared rationals
method.guard: Call only LinearSystemSolver._validated_residual_metrics; do not call spsolve, splu, or any FEM/model route
method.crosscheck: Recompute 100-digit mpmath relative residual and infinity-norm backward error from exact binary integer ratios
method.scope: Exact evaluation removes arithmetic uncertainty only for stored binary arrays. It does not bound input quantization, matrix assembly, physical model, or forward solution error.

status_policy: Exact PASS/FAIL concerns only stored represented matrices. J15 PYTEST_FAILED and all J15/J16 QF_GUARD_REJECTED statuses remain unchanged.
